hamburg-north-german-escapes-schaalsee-a.title: Schaalsee and Ratzeburg Lakes
hamburg-north-german-escapes-schaalsee-a.slogan: A 179 km loop out of Hamburg east
hamburg-north-german-escapes-schaalsee-a.story: Borderland lakes and small roads where pace comes from patience. Out of Glinde and back again: 179 km, roughly 3 h 43 in the saddle. On the way it passes Mölln, Ratzeburg lake road and Zarrentin water edge. Schaalsee biosphere stop is the high point. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Hamburg east gate → Mölln fuel gate
scenicChapters.narrative: 44 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Mölln fuel gate → Ratzeburg lake road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 14 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
